## One source of intelligence at every contract touchpoint.

Every contract contains institutional knowledge: your risk tolerance, negotiation patterns, approval processes, and post-signature obligations.

Luminance turns that knowledge into actionable intelligence to help your enterprise protect revenue, manage risk, and unlock more value from every contract.

## Built to understand the complexity of enterprise contracts.

Luminance combines specialist legal models with deep contractual context to understand contracts in context not just as text.

[See what makes Luminance different](https://www.luminance.com/platform/technology)

CONTRACT INTELLIGENCE

## What makes Contract Intelligence, intelligent?

Intelligence that compounds

Every contract, negotiation, and decision adds to your institutional knowledge. Luminance connects that knowledge, relationships and decisions, so it understands the context and informs what happens next – before you even ask.

Intelligence you can trust

Built on more than a decade of legal data and expertise, Luminance understands the complexity and context of contracts, analyzing entire contract portfolios across industries, jurisdictions, and business functions.

Intelligence for everyone

Luminance brings the insights teams need to uncover hidden risk, capture commercial opportunity and make better decisions. By making that intelligence accessible across the enterprise, Luminance helps teams act with confidence, move work forward and create greater value from every contract.

Intelligence that keeps the enterprise in motion

Luminance connects Contract Intelligence to the processes that move your business forward. Automate routine work at scale with AI agents, keep contracts moving and act on revenue opportunities before value is left on the table. Move faster, realize revenue sooner and keep the enterprise in motion.

Trust at every layer

## Security engineered for the enterprise

ISO 27001

Luminance maintains an independently certified Information Security Management System covering the development, operation, sales, and support of its technology platform.

SOC 2 TYPE II

Luminance undergoes regular SOC 2 Type II examinations to provide ongoing independent assurance over controls related to security, availability, and confidentiality.

Independent Penetration Testing

Independent third parties regularly test the Luminance application and operational systems against evolving threats. Further information is available through the security review process.

[Learn more](https://trust.luminance.com/)
